scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Screened 2,313 unique recent cs.AI/cs.CL/cs.RO titles with expanded benchmark, training, distillation, optimization, reasoning, memory, synthetic-data, agent and automated-research coverage, overlapping the November24 full pass and trailing30days. Reused57 documented prior scope exclusions; verified553 additional primary abstracts and explicit v1 histories: 461 additions and92 scope exclusions. Preserved original dates of historical omissions. Checked58 official project/artifact sources (two unavailable) and read nine important full papers, discovering27 further official GitHub repos. Re-searched official vendor news sources and reassessed all10 prior picks. Under explicit maintainer delegation to select Top10 and push without confirmation, directly published the November28 edition with five research and five flagship stories, true first-public dates and attributed claims. Split complete collections into generated catalog pages with20-paper README previews to stay within GitHub rendering limits. Bounded search, not global literature completeness.

metrics_refresh.note: Fresh title-verified OpenAlex known work-ID and arXiv/DOI batches, followed by title search of uncovered records. Semantic Scholar initial batch returned HTTP 429, so no further S2 calls were made. Retain max(existing, verified observations); never turn failures/unmatched results into zeros. Authenticated GitHub REST for every configured repository plus independently discovered project-linked repositories. Considered all 2,477 records: 4 citation counts remain unknown and 15 historical known counts lack fresh verification. Four historical repositories returned authenticated 404; retain their previous stars. Twenty-seven official repositories were discovered separately from live author project pages. Four newly found author repository links returned 404 at ingestion and were not inserted with fabricated stars. A conference venue URL incorrectly captured as code was cleared.
